role: declared sample space with sigma-finite reference measure of positive total mass
notes: nu fixes the coordinate in which spread is measured; in the finite case nu{x}=w(x)>0. The glyph nu is used for other measures elsewhere in P15; scoped to this chapter.

role: declared constraint functions and declared expectation values
notes: Jaynes writes <f_r(x)> for the expectation of f_r under the assigned distribution (Phys. Rev. 106, p. 623, eq. (2-8)); kept in the multiplier equations.

role: feasible set: probabilities absolutely continuous w.r.t. nu with every f_k integrable and E_P f_k=c_k
notes: Not a sigma-algebra; local to this chapter.

role: entropy relative to nu, -int p ln p dnu, extended-real when defined
notes: With counting measure equals Jaynes's H with K=1 (eq. (2-3)). H also names a different Shannon-entropy convention (base 2) in sec:p15-rationality-4-1.

role: attainable moment set of the declared statistics
notes: Convex; equals conv f(X) in the finite case.

role: value of the declared maximum-entropy problem (sup of entropy over feasible set, -infinity if empty)
partition function int exp(-lambda.f) dnu with values in (0,infinity] and its finiteness domain
notes: Jaynes's Z(lambda_1,...,lambda_m), eq. (2-9). Z is also a partition function in thm:p15-measurement-asymmetric-model (same role, one multiplier).

role: Lagrange multipliers and the normalization constant lambda_0=ln Z
notes: Jaynes's notation, eqs. (2-10)-(2-12). lambda is also a Poisson parameter in sec:p15-de-moivre-laplace-and-stirling; scoped here.

role: exponential-family probability with density exp(-lambda_0-lambda.f) relative to nu
dual function ln Z(lambda)+lambda.c, +infinity off Lambda
notes: Equals Jaynes's S_max of eq. (2-13) at a solution of the multiplier equations.

role: relative entropy int p ln(p/q) dnu for q>0 a.e.
notes: Same role as D(p,q) in thm:p15-rmdl-gibbs and D(t||p) in sec:p15-de-moivre-laplace-and-stirling; measure-theoretic form here.

role: auxiliary function t ln t - t + 1 with phi(0)=1
union of supports of feasible distributions in the finite case
uncertainty of n equally likely alternatives, H(1/n,...,1/n)
reference measure x^n dx on (0,infinity), n>-1
notes: Jaynes's density of states rho(x)=x^n/epsilon (p. 625) without the constant 1/epsilon.
